refined_nucleus: A curved, armoured optical heart rate sensor lens is integrated into a smartwatch with a dynamic calibration system to reduce motion artifacts caused by arm movement and muscle contractions.
new_relationship: The dynamic calibration system creates a feedback loop between the optical heart rate sensor and the curved lens to adjust for motion artifacts in real-time.
new_configuration: The curved lens and armoured surface are integrated with a microcontroller and a sensor to detect arm movement and muscle contractions.
new_control_rule: The control logic is updated to include a dynamic calibration algorithm that adjusts the signal processing based on the detected arm movement and muscle contractions.
refined_structure: The curved lens is placed on the front of the smartwatch, and the armoured surface is integrated into the lens's design. The microcontroller and sensor are embedded within the smartwatch.
refined_causal_chain: Optical heart rate sensor calibration drift during exercise
Causes motion artifacts in the photoplethysmographic signal
Intervention: integrate curved lens, armoured surface, and dynamic calibration system
Mechanism: curved lens and armoured surface reduce motion artifacts, dynamic calibration system adjusts for motion artifacts in real-time
Effect: improved accuracy of heart rate monitoring during exercise
Response: accurate heart rate monitoring during exercise
